name: GitLab Board
author: o_devvy
description: A GitLab issue board in a bar popup: your project's real boards, issue details, and a board picker.

barWidget.description: Shows a GitLab board's lists as columns. Click an issue for its details; switch project and board from the popup.

schema.label: Default GitLab project
schema.description: Project opened on shell start, e.g. group/project. Star a board in the picker to change the default board.
